integrity: All stated field calculations use exact coefficient extraction and Groebner-basis smoothness checks in the included Python programs; arithmetic assertions are proved using standard cohomology and tame Prym isogeny facts. No external validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only the characteristic-three symmetric bidegree-(4,4) filling family, not arbitrary nonsymmetric members; does not determine the complete zeta functions, all Newton slopes, or full endomorphism rings. Remaining historical-priority risk from unindexed calculations.
title: An almost-ordinary Prym on every smooth symmetric minimal filling curve over \(\mathbb F_3\)
